scripts.watch:wasm: nodemon --watch sim/src --watch sim/Cargo.toml --ext rs,toml --delay 300ms --exec "npm run build:wasm"
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && concurrently -n wasm,web -c yellow,cyan -k "npm run watch:wasm" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build -w web
